# Review

1. Read the whole diff before commenting.
2. For anything touching auth, input parsing or secrets, hand it to security-check.

## Review

List the findings, most serious first, one line each, then the details.

Every finding needs evidence: a file and line, a command with its output, or a link.
Say "I don't know" rather than guess.
